profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, traded under the ticker TSM and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001046179. On its own site, the company describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987, supporting an ecosystem of global customers and partners with what it calls the industry's leading process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions. It also describes its business model as accelerating innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, and points to its contribution to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The material available does not identify specific AI products from the company, and no AI products, MCP servers, or lawsuits are recorded for it. Its stated position rests on semiconductor manufacturing and design enablement rather than on named AI offerings.
